artifact_type: ranking.v2 normalization audit; not a production release
cohort_policy: Complete configured candidate cities plus enabled, complete references; sorted canonical CBSA IDs.

feature_registry.definition: 1991–2020 annual snowfall normal; missing is not zero.
feature_registry.label: Annual snowfall

feature_registry.definition: Days with maximum temperature at least 90°F (32.2°C).
feature_registry.label: Days at or above 90°F

feature_registry.definition: Grouped ACS duration estimate; commuting proxy, not measured congestion.
feature_registry.label: Mean commute

feature_registry.definition: TIGER road centerline km per CBSA land km².
feature_registry.label: Road density

feature_registry.definition: Consolidated TIGER network junctions per CBSA land km².
feature_registry.label: Intersection density

feature_registry.definition: Share of included road length classified as freeway or ramp.
feature_registry.label: Freeway share

feature_registry.definition: Share of included road length classified as secondary roads.
feature_registry.label: Arterial share

feature_registry.definition: Share of included road length classified as local, service, or alley roads.
feature_registry.label: Local road share

feature_registry.definition: Operational public DC ports divided by population times 100,000. Not secured fleet capacity.
feature_registry.label: Public DC charging

feature_registry.definition: Population share in counties with at least one operational public DC port; not travel-time access.
feature_registry.label: County charging coverage

feature_registry.definition: ACS resident population; not observed ride-hailing demand.
feature_registry.label: Resident population

feature_registry.definition: Population divided by CBSA land area excluding water.
feature_registry.label: Population density

feature_registry.definition: Households without an available vehicle divided by all households.
feature_registry.label: Zero-vehicle households

feature_registry.definition: Public transit commuters divided by applicable workers; transit also competes with ride-hailing.
feature_registry.label: Transit commute share
